facts.fact: The document is a Final Draft National ICT Policy dated May 2022, prepared by a consultant for the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance and signed in a foreword by the Minister; it states no adoption.
The draft lists the National ICT Policy 2014 among the key policies of the ICT sector's current policy environment, which the draft revises.
The full text of the final draft is available online on the consultant's website; it is a draft, and the document gives no official publication.
The draft contains no implementation or action plan; it states the Ministry will develop a road map informing a monitoring and evaluation framework and implementation matrix.

The draft makes the Ministry of ICT and National Guidance responsible for policy guidance, oversight, and leading adoption, implementation, monitoring and evaluation, working with the Digital Transformation Programme Working Group.
The draft states no budget, cost or funding source for the policy.
